prior_results_preserved: issue-139-real-windows.json and its original runtime output directory were not modified.
method: All three real annotation paths; one disabled slicing warmup per path; two off/on pairs in off/on then on/off order; each treatment backprojects its own sliced intensity output. No retries, resumption, or pixel hashing.
timing: Existing SliceParallelPipelineStep / BackprojectPipelineStep durations. Setup before data operations and final reporting/delivery are excluded. The external Pipeline.process timer is retained separately.
source_invariance: The isolated Windows production digest matches the repository before and after the batch. Subsequent changes during the batch affected only tests, documentation, and the CI coverage badge.

dependency_workaround.scope: Isolated Windows test dependency only, identical for reporting off/on; repository dependency unchanged. Zero-duration transfer-monitor intervals represented as one microsecond.
dependency_workaround.reason: Windows Python 3.11 time.monotonic uses GetTickCount64 at 15.625 ms resolution; CloudFiles rejects zero-width transfer intervals.
